title: 第二十三章 打死副会长实力暴露第二十四章 贱女人我来找你了
slug: 修炼一天抵十年莫欺老年穷
lines: 袁破军骤然拔剑了，黑色剑匣内发出尖锐刺耳的声音，好似被束缚已久的魔龙骤然脱困而出，一身上下所有剑气全都涌入到了宝剑之中。
使得整个宝剑都直接变成了一层乌黑色泽。
宛如燃烧起了一片片诡异魔火。
一股惊心动魄，足以粉碎一切的力量，从这把宝剑之中直接爆发而出。
他脚掌一踏，速度好似残影，刹那消失不见。
一剑直劈林玄。
这一剑，乃是他胸中十几年剑气的全力爆发。
这一剑，乃是他一身力量的完美宣泄。
林玄那边眼瞳一缩，不为所动，原本苍老瘦削的身躯，竟如同充气一样，刹那膨胀、鼓起，周身上下一根根粗大血管瞬间浮现。
体内一股炽热的猩红气血猛然爆发。
好似瀑布一样，冲起好几米高。
一股凶残、狂暴，难以言喻的气息，直接从林玄那边冲击而出。
他脚掌一踏，膨胀变大的身躯，刹那直冲而过，眼瞳森寒，杀机暴涨，一只拳头轮动起来，聚集一身气血与劲力，好似电光毒龙钻，直接向着袁破军手中长剑狠狠砸去。
轰隆！
一道刺耳的金属声音爆发。
而后一股股强大可怕的力量，好似洁白色的气罡一样，向着四面八方快速横扫，使得四周的桌椅板凳狠狠爆炸、成粉。
方圆七八米的地面，都瞬间凹陷、爆开。
坚硬的青冈石地板，当场粉碎成无数碎屑。
一块块碎屑被力量所激，直接向着四面八方激射而去。
噗噗噗噗噗！
一上来很多秘武弟子纷纷发出惨叫，被这些碎屑贯穿，打的鲜血淋漓，倒飞而出。
那些记者、摄像师，更是惊恐大叫，连忙快速躲闪。
就连原本架起来的摄像机，也被打坏、倒飞而出。
但好在胶卷还在，不至于损毁。
整个厅堂之内，一片混乱。
正在手持长剑的袁破军，脸色一变，顿时出现了之前和傅剑秋一样的感觉，瞬间感受到了无数刚猛恐怖的劲力，好似密密麻麻的钢针一样，钻入到他的体内，摧枯拉朽。
一道惨叫突然发出。
手中的长剑也握不住，被一股恐怖的劲力当场震得脱手而出，这边他刚想往后倒退，林玄便身躯一闪，刹那出现在他的近前。
眼神冰冷，惊心动魄，让他心生恐惧。
咔嚓！
砰！
content_en:
Clang! ! !
Yuan Pojun suddenly drew his sword, and a sharp and harsh sound came from the black sword box, as if the dragon that had been restrained for a long time suddenly escaped from its trap, and all the sword energy on his body poured into the sword.
The entire sword turned directly into a layer of jet-black color.
It was like pieces of strange demonic fire were burning.
A thrilling power, enough to crush everything, erupted directly from this sword.
He stepped on the ball of his foot and disappeared as fast as an afterimage.
A sword struck Lin Xuan directly.
This sword was the full force of the sword energy that had been in his chest for more than ten years.
This sword is the perfect expression of his strength.
Lin Xuan's eyes shrank and remained unmoved. His old and thin body suddenly expanded and bulged as if it were inflated, and thick blood vessels all over his body suddenly appeared.
A hot scarlet blood burst out in his body.
Like a waterfall, it rises several meters high.
A ferocious, violent, and indescribable aura rushed out directly from Lin Xuan.
He stepped on the soles of his feet, and his swollen body rushed forward in an instant. His eyes were cold and his murderous intent surged. One of his fists started to rotate, gathering energy, blood and strength. Like an electric light poisonous dragon diamond, it directly hit the long sword in Yuan Pojun's hand.
Boom!
A harsh metallic sound erupted.
Then waves of powerful and terrifying force, like pure white energy, swept rapidly in all directions, causing the surrounding tables, chairs and benches to explode and turn into powder.
The ground with a radius of seven to eight meters was instantly dented and exploded.
The hard green granite floor was shattered into countless pieces on the spot.
Pieces of debris were stimulated by the force and shot directly in all directions.
Puff puff puff puff puff!
"Ah!"
As soon as they came up, many secret martial arts disciples screamed in agony and were pierced by these debris, bleeding and flying backwards.
The reporters and cameramen screamed in fear and quickly evaded.
Even the camera that was originally set up was broken and flew upside down.
But fortunately, the film is still there and will not be damaged.
The entire hall was in chaos.
Yuan Pojun, who was holding the long sword, changed his face. He suddenly felt the same as Fu Jianqiu before. He instantly felt countless fierce and terrifying forces, like dense steel needles, drilling into his body, destroying everything.
"Ah!"
A scream suddenly came out.
He couldn't hold the long sword in his hand, and was shaken out by a terrifying force. Just as he was about to step back, Lin Xuan's body flashed and appeared in front of him in an instant.
The eyes were cold and thrilling, making him fearful.
"Don't..."
Click!
Bang!
